Strategy: Reward the sweet band between thirty and forty-five always, plus a second band between sixty and seventy-five only when at least five bins are open, keeping the mid penalty. This keeps two reusable leftover sizes available, but the second band may split attention and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (15 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 60 and r - item <= 75 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
